ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25; high-intensity white dominates the central ventral surface, bordered by low-intensity black along the trailing edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white region centrally distributed across both lobes; black pigmentation forms a thick, irregular band (approx. 10-15% of lobe width) along the entire trailing edge. Small grey-scale mottling clusters are visible in the lower-left ventral quadrant near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate angle of 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes; depth is roughly 1/6th of total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration; peaks and valleys range from 5 to 15 pixels in amplitude; most pronounced and jagged on the right lobe distal half.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory for both lobes; right lobe exhibits a more pronounced outward sweep terminating in a sharp, dark tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized cluster of approx. 8-12 circular high-contrast white spots (barnacle colonies) located along the leading edge/dorsal wrap of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical grey linear disruptions visible on the white ventral surface of the left lobe, likely representing superficial rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on the left leading edge; significant irregular indentations and nicks across the trailing edge topography of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black pigmentation hook at the distal tip of the right lobe; distinct water-shedding pixel streaks falling from trailing edge serrations.
